record.title: incident retro for the phishing wave from last week
record.summary: The team reviewed the phishing incident where 214 users received the email, 9 clicked, and 3 entered credentials on a fake ADFS page. All three users reset their credentials within an hour, and no successful logins occurred from attacker infrastructure. The timeline showed a 38-minute gap between the first reported click (09:14) and first containment action (09:52), with 11 minutes attributed to Marcus being in a meeting. This highlighted a process gap requiring a documented escalation that does not route through a single person. Additionally, the fake page was live for six hours before the first report, suggesting a canary token in the login footer template would have caught the clone at hour zero. Users who reported the incident received no acknowledgment, leading to duplicate reports. Regarding scope, the finance group still lacks phishing-resistant MFA due to an exemption from the ERP migration, but the vendor now supports FIDO keys, making removal non-disruptive.
